name: Ozark heart-leaf aster
desc: Ozark heart-leaf aster (Symphyotrichum drummondii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Symphyotrichum drummondii is a species of flowering plant of the family Asteraceae native to the central and eastern United States. The common name Drummond's aster has been used for the species.
